note: `devdb plan milestone list --plan <slug>` (and `plan item list`) return `[]` even when the slug is valid; the `--plan` flag on LIST verbs accepts only the plan UUID, not the slug, duplicating the closed M1.2 gap (`b148e8e7`) that fixed the ADD verbs but missed the LIST siblings. Proposed fix: apply the same slug→id resolution path used in milestone/item `add` to their `list` siblings, and fail closed on `--plan <unknown>` instead of silently returning `[]`.
